reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the getUpcomingDates try/captureBreadcrumb pattern, but writes its own daily-vs-other weekend dispatch instead of sharing the one getNextDate already has.

duplication.why: The 'skipWeekend ? (daily ? skip : move) : keep' decision duplicates the branch inside shared getNextDate, and the RSchedule setup/error handling repeats getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts as expected, though the per-occurrence weekend decision belongs in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable, but the daily-skip rule now lives in two places with different shapes, and the ±2-day widened query window is an unexplained magic constant for the weekend shift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the move case; the tree has no shared function for the daily-skip decision to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange: the daily-skip/weekend-move dispatch from shared/schedules.ts getNextDate is rewritten as a map-to-null-then-filter chain instead of being extracted and shared.
